pages.title: Annihilation Core
pages.text: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction inside a box. Matter and antimatter meet and convert entirely into energy, the most efficient fuel possible. Dilithium slows the reaction so it releases steadily rather than all at once. It glows white-hot, but the box stays cool.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Antimatter Penning Trap I let antimatter seep through Dilithium Crystal into a superfluid helium bath. Instead of a crater, it gave me a steady glow I could tap for power.
Made in $(item)Antimatter Penning Trap$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Annihilation Power.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Neutrino Flux.
